headline: Colombian peso weakens 4.06% in 30 days, trailing only Brazilian real
summary: The Colombian peso fell 4.06% between Oct. 17 and Nov. 17, marking the second-largest monthly depreciation in the region behind the Brazilian real's 12% drop.
why: Currency depreciation raises imported inflation risks for Latin American economies and complicates central bank rate-easing trajectories.

impacts.name: Colombian Peso
impacts.why: The currency retreated 4.06% over the past month amid regional foreign exchange pressure.
